integrity: A complete combinatorial proof is supplied; two independent finite verification approaches corroborate the statement. No claim of formal or independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only binary linear words and scattered a^r b a b patterns for r>=2; exact bit-complexity and other pattern families not treated. Earlier unindexed equivalent results remain a possible priority risk.
title: Exact binary Parikh-class avoidance for the one-return family \(a^r b a b\)
